title: Codex session whose thread rollout file is missing fails every turn ("failed to resolve rollout path … file does not exist") instead of recovering
outcome: A Codex session whose persisted thread can't be resumed, because its rollout file is gone, recovers to a usable state: a new thread, with the loss clearly reported to the operator. It doesn't fail every turn and park its queue.
acceptance: A test with a missing rollout file shows the session recovering to a new thread (or an explicit operator choice) with a visible notice, and the queued prompt is delivered once.
The error state and the queue pause give the operator a stated reason and a next action; Resume doesn't loop into the same failure.
